## Classes

### `class SoulPhysicalStorage`

Complete immutable physical generations over the original OS storage owner. A verified save is historical evidence; this owner never adopts a world, unloads canonical objects, retries an uncertain write or deletes archives.

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor({storage,worldId}={})` |  |
| `saveGeneration` | `saveGeneration(world)` |  |
| `loadGeneration` | `loadGeneration()` |  |
| `prepareGenerationLoad` | `prepareGenerationLoad({reservedAllocation=0}={})` | Retain one immutable, original load result while the App stages its owners. This ticket never adopts a World or grants actor effect/release authority. |
| `activateGeneration` | `activateGeneration(ticket,activate)` | Recheck the exact selected head observation, then consume the ticket and synchronously enter the App's replacement gate. This read is not a mutex against other workers; durable journal publication uses its own exact CAS. |
| `releaseGenerationLoad` | `releaseGenerationLoad(ticket)` |  |
| `status` | `status()` |  |
| `dispose` | `dispose()` |  |
